margins.source: decision-38 fallback (B1's own null, cell B1r)

twin.role: read beside (content / form decomposition), never a gate

cell_kind: EFFICIENCY -- the efficiency tables are the deliverable; the paired score read is a non-inferiority guard
claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows, plus a cost measurement of the same flight. No superiority, generalization, component-causal, bar or confirmatory claim; no cross-carrier claim; no geometry claim.

decision_rule.comparator: the sealed B1-notool arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-EXEMPLARS-K20-NOTOOL-V1, and nothing else, for every gating clause; the twin is read beside, never as a gate of this cell
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: BOTH guards non-inferior at B1's own-null margins: the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta exceeds -1.2350 AND the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -1.2212; where an interval straddles zero the verdict says 'non-inferiority proven, superiority not claimed'. NEUTRAL-or-better admits the index into the SLURP default plan only once the twin has sealed and the content effect (IDX minus IDXT) is reported, and only if the measured cost is lower than the base's (decision 50); a NEUTRAL index that does not lower cost stays out.
decision_rule.ADMITTED: NEUTRAL and, in addition, the pooled SLU CI95 lower bound above zero: reported as a gain, entered as ADMITTED.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: owner decision 25's form: a MEASURED LOSS on either guard -- a point estimate below -h or a CI95 UPPER bound below zero. Then the form is closed at these defaults; a different granularity, ordering or budget is a new one-factor registration and the owner decides (decision 52's defaults are provisional).
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict
decision_rule.scenario_diagnostic: the decision-17 net-harmed flag per scenario (five or more) is reported; a breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate
decision_rule.consumption: decision 61: the verdict states CONSUMPTION / NON-CONSUMPTION / MISLEADING TERSENESS / undecided from the index-consumption read (diagnostics_required); NON-CONSUMPTION routes to the richer-granularity variant, MISLEADING TERSENESS closes the form at decision 52's defaults, CONSUMPTION leaves the NEUTRAL / ADMITTED / HARMFUL verdict to stand on its own

delta_convention: delta = IDX minus the sealed anchor, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: FINITE COMPLETIONS. The count of rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is "finite_completion", the affected sample ids, the delivered-draft versus abstention split, and -- only if the count is non-zero -- the primary official metric recomputed with those rows excluded BESIDE the registered all-rows number, which stays the number the decision rule reads. No row is ever filtered out of the scored manifest. Expected zero; the anchor side is provably zero (docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json).

planner_action_illegal. The flight's own count, the sample ids that carry it, and their action character counts and SHA-256 values (the form inherited from the B7a recovery note's section 8). This is the failure item E8c repaired; it is reported whether or not it is zero.

FIRST-REQUEST BYTE IDENTITY, stated honestly before contact. The first request of a row is the Perception request, and under this factor it is NOT byte-identical to the base's: the system message carries the constant L0+L1 index as a suffix of the contract fill, and the row's pointer block plus budgeted expansions replace the per-row slot-contract cards and the raw exemplar block. What IS claimed, and what the smoke proves, is (a) ONE system-message sha256 over every contact of every row (the index is constant), (b) no byte before the expansion block moves relative to the render proof's prediction, (c) the index receipt (view id, release and snapshot pins, per-contact selected ids) is present on every contact, and (d) no request carries a tools array. A second system-message sha, a missing receipt or a tools array is a FAILURE. A differing Solver, Reviewer or Planner request whose upstream model response differs is reported, not silently excused: greedy decoding at temperature 0 is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions.
THE CONSTANCY TABLE per row from the sealed receipt: mode, rendered_tool_names, the five contact rows with authority_tool_names beside rendered_tool_names, and distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1.

NATIVE TASK-CONTRACT CALL COUNT against the anchor's realized 1,082, and the count of tool calls emitted by a role that holds no authority (expected zero; a non-zero count is not a failure of the flight -- the rail refuses the call and the episode continues -- but it is the single most interesting behavioural consequence of showing three more roles the tool definitions, and it is reported per role).

PER-SCENARIO intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios, in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting, plus net harmed rows per scenario with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17) -- a diagnostic the verdict must carry, not an additional gate.
ROW ACCOUNTING: 1,080 in, 1,080 out on both sides, no row dropped and no sample_id invented.

COST: actual generation contacts against the anchor's realized 5,417 and the 11,880 ceiling; actual repeated speech seconds against the anchor's realized 15,459.76; actual FIT endpoints; GPU hours read from the serving monitor over the lease window.

INDEX CONSUMPTION (owner emphasis 2026-09-20, decision 61). An index that looks reasonable may be unconsumable by the frozen core because an L0/L1 line carries too little reference information; this read decides that question with the sealed outputs and receipts alone, model-free. (a) CITATIONS: Solver outputs that cite index ids -- count, distinct ids, resolved versus unresolved, share of rows with at least one citation, and whether a cited id's line or card is consistent with the delivered intent / slot types. (b) POINTER USE: per row, whether the delivered intent lies in the row's pointer-block intent set and whether the delivered slot types lie in the pointed slot set; the same shares computed on the BASE's sealed outputs against the SAME pointer blocks (rendered model-free from the sealed receipts), so that 'the answer follows the pointers' is measured against 'the answer would have followed them anyway'. (c) EXPANSION USE: for slot types whose L2 card was expanded on a row versus slot types only pointed, the delivered slot-type precision / recall and the filler format-compliance rate against the L1 'Admissible formats' line (one regex per slot type derived from the view), on this cell and on the base. (d) FORMAT COMPLIANCE overall: the share of delivered fillers matching an admissible format, this cell versus the base versus the other index cell. (e) THE TRIPLE: base / IDX / IDXT on official SLU-F1 and intent. CONSUMPTION is evidenced when IDX differs from IDXT beyond the own null AND (a)-(d) move in the same direction as the score; NON-CONSUMPTION is evidenced when IDX lies inside IDXT's null, citations are near zero and (b)-(d) do not move against the base; MISLEADING TERSENESS is evidenced when IDX lies below the base with (d) worse. Each of the three is stated in the verdict with its evidence, or 'undecided' with the reason. CONTINGENCY, fixed here: on NON-CONSUMPTION the next cell is the richer-granularity variant of the same view on the same base (intent L2 activation cards through expansion_budget.intent_card > 0 and / or a larger slot_card budget; a new one-factor registration), not the closure of the index form; on MISLEADING TERSENESS the form is closed at decision 52's defaults and the owner decides; on CONSUMPTION the decision rule's own verdict stands.
efficiency_tables_required: HEADLINE EFFICIENCY: prefilled tokens per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, wall seconds per row, contacts per row, aggregate prefill tok/s and aggregate decode tok/s -- IDX beside the anchor's own realized cost block and beside the B4b reference, with every number's source named (run manifest, flight receipts, monitor, or server.log).

PER-POSITION TABLE over the five positions perception / solver / reviewer 1 / reviewer 2 / planner: prompt tokens, prefilled tokens, cached share, generated tokens, speech-packet re-decode share and prefilled tokens per row -- IDX beside the B4b reference of arms.efficiency_reference_not_an_arm, with the reference labelled as a reference on every row.
CONSTANCY: distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 per row (must be 1 on all 1,080), rendered_tool_names, and authority_tool_names per role -- from the sealed saea-native-tool-schema-rendering-v1 block.

PREFILL JOIN QUALITY: the share of contacts on which n_tokens - generated + 1 equals the client's usage.prompt_tokens. Below 100.00 % the per-role figures are reported as estimates, not measurements, and the verdict says so.
CLIENT PROMPT TOKENS per row and the per-contact delta at each of the three tool-free positions, stated as an EXPECTED RISE and explicitly not a regression.
SLOT OCCUPANCY AND UTILISATION over the lease window: mean busy slots, zero-busy share, parked fraction, mean utilisation, GPU power -- from flight receipts and monitor.jsonl.

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

output.harness_admission: on NEUTRAL the coordinator writes the harness-admission entry in the form the protocol document's harness_admission_entry_form records, and adds the key to the SLURP default plan
output.prints_only_aggregates: no utterance text, no filler and no gold is printed or persisted by the read

resampling.clusters: 125 speaker clusters, 18 scenarios of 60 rows, 523 headset and 557 far-field rows, from the released roster metadata
resampling.interval_form: percentile pairs of the same retained replicate sequence
resampling.pairing_note: both sides of this contrast are decoded runs, so the paired interval carries real decoding noise; the own-null margins are the calibration for exactly that. A NON-INFERIORITY read is the correct shape here precisely because the expected true effect is zero.
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

scorer.projection_v3_companion: slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train, reported beside every official number (owner decision 7)
scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer
scorer.symmetric_normalised_companion: slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1-train, the TRAIN sibling registered under owner decision 14, reported beside every official number

tables_required: headline score: the anchor, IDX, the delta, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, the scenario-stratified CI90 and the equal-scenario delta, for official pooled SLU-F1 and intent
per-scenario intent and SLU over all 18 scenarios, in both weightings
net harmed rows per scenario, with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17)
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p
projection v3 and the TRAIN symmetric number beside every official number
the mandatory diagnostics of the protocol document's diagnostics_required, in order

the index-consumption tables (decision 61): citations; pointer use on this cell and on the base against the same pointer blocks; expansion use by slot type; format compliance; the base / IDX / IDXT triple
